skill.name: executing-plans
skill.description: Guides an AI coding assistant through batched execution of a written implementation plan with review checkpoints and verification reports.
skill.summary: Execute written implementation plans in small verified batches with feedback checkpoints.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in the prompt-only skill. Manual review of SKILL.md found no prompt injection attempt, data exfiltration intent, or unsafe tool instruction.

content.value_statement: Long implementation plans can drift without review and verification. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through batched execution with checkpoints.
actual_capabilities: Guides the assistant to read and review a written plan before starting work.
Uses a default first batch of three tasks for controlled execution.
Directs task tracking from in progress to completed for each plan item.
Requires verification steps from the plan to be run during execution.
Reports implemented work and verification output between batches.
Instructs the assistant to stop and ask when blockers or unclear steps appear.
limitations: Requires a written implementation plan before it can guide execution.
Does not provide project-specific test commands or acceptance criteria.
Depends on human feedback between batches before continuing safely.
References a finishing sub-skill that is not included in this package.

use_cases.title: Plan-Guided Feature Delivery
use_cases.description: Execute a prepared implementation plan in small batches with verification after each task.

use_cases.title: Reviewable Agent Sessions
use_cases.description: Keep AI coding work inspectable by requiring reports before the next batch starts.

use_cases.title: Controlled Refactor Execution
use_cases.description: Apply a multi-step refactor plan while stopping for unclear instructions or repeated failures.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Simple Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this implementation plan and execute the first batch. Review it first, then report completed work and verification results.

prompt_templates.title: Run With Checkpoints
prompt_templates.prompt: Execute this written plan in batches of three tasks. Stop after each batch and wait for review before continuing.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Unclear Steps
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this plan critically before starting. If any step is unclear or unsafe, ask questions before making changes.

prompt_templates.title: Complete a Large Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the plan as the source of truth. Track each task, run specified verifications, report checkpoints, and finish only after all tasks pass.

output_examples.input: A developer provides a six-step feature implementation plan.
output_examples.output: The assistant reviews the plan, completes the first three tasks, reports changes, shows verification results, and waits for feedback.

output_examples.input: A refactor plan includes a missing dependency and unclear verification command.
output_examples.output: The assistant stops before guessing, explains the blocker, and asks for the missing dependency and command details.

output_examples.input: A team lead asks for continued execution after approving the first report.
output_examples.output: The assistant applies requested changes, starts the next batch, updates task status, and reports the next verification checkpoint.

best_practices: Provide a written plan with small tasks and explicit verification steps.
Review each checkpoint report before asking the assistant to continue.
Clarify blockers immediately instead of allowing guessed implementation steps.
anti_patterns: Using the skill without a concrete implementation plan.
Continuing through failed tests or unclear instructions without review.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps an AI assistant execute a written implementation plan in controlled batches with review checkpoints.

faq.question: Does it create implementation plans?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for executing an existing plan, not for planning from scratch.

faq.question: How many tasks does it run at once?
faq.answer: The skill uses a default first batch of three tasks before reporting for review.

faq.question: Can it be used with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What happens when a blocker appears?
faq.answer: The assistant should stop, explain the blocker, and ask for clarification instead of guessing.

faq.question: Is this skill safe to publish?
faq.answer: The reviewed skill is prompt-only, and no malicious instructions or suspicious static patterns were found.
